title: Base-change, proper-refinement and identity equations for the graph map
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. For the specific core canonicalEtaleCompactSupportCore defined in [lem-asd-compact-support-graph-derived-isomorphism], the proposition EtaleCompactSupportCoherence [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison] holds. Thus its comparison $a^{-1}$ intertwines the specified compact-support and sum exchanges for every change of locally Noetherian quasi-compact base; for every proper refinement [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] its comparisons obey the exact direct-image-composition equation of that proposition; and for the proper identity compactification it equals identityEtaleCompactSupportComparison. These are equations of actual unbounded derived transformations. No adjoint-uniqueness or double-base-change clause is assumed.

proof.text:
Check the actual exchange by transposition. Write $t:\overline U'\to\overline U$ and $E_j:t^*Dj_!\to Dj'_!h^*$ for the specified inverse open-extension comparison. Let $\theta:r'^*g^*\to t^*r^*$ be the inverse-image square comparison. The graph projections of [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison] give, on exact derived functors,
$$\delta'_{h^*K}\circ r'^*(C^\Sigma_K)=E_{j,K}\circ t^*(\delta_K)\circ\theta_{Du_{\Sigma!}K}.\tag{*}$$
To verify this identity without testing derived morphisms on stalks, pull the graph decomposition back to $V'=\overline U'\times_{X'}U'$. On its graph component both sides take the section of the corresponding lift to that same section, and on the complementary component both sides are zero. The comparisons $\beta$ are adjunction-preserving: by their defining conjugacy they are the left-adjoint comparisons of the equality of the restriction/direct-image functors on the localized sites. Thus the comparisons in the two pasted rectangles coincide by [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting], and the composition comparison $\lambda$ is normalized by those same adjunctions. This makes the preceding component calculation an equality of sheaf natural transformations; [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property] descends it to (*) on arbitrary complexes. Now transpose $C^{(j,r)}_K\circ g^*a_K$ under $r'^*\dashv Rr'_*$. The definition of proper exchange in [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] gives its transpose as the right side of (*): naturality moves $a_K$ past the pulled-back counit, and $\varepsilon_r\circ r^*a_K=\delta_K$ by the triangle identity. The transpose of $a'_{h^*K}\circ C^\Sigma_K$ is the left side of (*). Injectivity of the adjunction bijection proves
$$C^{(j,r)}\circ g^*a=(a'h^*)\circ C^\Sigma.$$
No equality of derived morphisms has been inferred merely from equality on cohomology.

proof.text: For a proper refinement $p:\overline U_1\to\overline U_2$ with $pj_1=j_2$, apply [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange] to the square with top $j_1$, bottom $j_2$, left vertical $1_U$ and right vertical $p$. It gives the specified unbounded isomorphism $b_p:Dj_{2!}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*Dj_{1!}$. Its sheaf support identification is the identity on the underlying sections over $U$, and its K-injective recipe fixes the derived normalization. Composing $Rr_{2*}b_p$ with the direct-image composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] gives $\rho_p:Rr_{2*}Dj_{2!}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rr_{1*}Dj_{1!}$. Its refinement composition and identity laws follow from the vertical-pasting and identity clauses of the same interchange node. All its hypotheses hold: $A$ is finite, both vertical maps are proper, both horizontal maps are open, and the compactifications are between Noetherian schemes. No cartesian hypothesis is needed for this application.

proof.text: Put $B=Du_{\Sigma!}K$. Under $r_1^*=p^*r_2^*\dashv Rr_{2*}Rp_*$ the transpose of $\rho_pa_2$ is $\varepsilon_p\circ p^*b_p\circ p^*\delta_2$. By [lem-asd-proper-open-refinement-adjoint-projection], its first two factors equal the degreewise clopen projection $D\pi_p$. On each graph summand, $p^*\delta_2$ retains the lifts landing on the graph for $j_2$, and $D\pi_p$ retains among those the lifts landing on $j_1(U)$. Their composite therefore retains exactly the graph summands for $j_1$, acting identically on each, and kills the others: it is $\delta_1$. These are termwise maps, descended by localization. The composite-adjunction counit formula in [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] gives the displayed transpose, so the adjunction bijection proves $\rho_pa_2=a_1$, hence $c_1\rho_p=c_2$. For refinements $p:1\to2$, $q:2\to3$, this identity gives $\rho_p\rho_q=a_1c_2a_2c_3=a_1c_3=\rho_{qp}$; for identity refinements it gives $a_ic_i=1$.

proof.text: For the identity compactification, the graph projection is identity. The right-derived unit of the identity direct image is inverse to its exact-derived comparison. The lowerStarId comparison and right unitor therefore give precisely identityEtaleCompactSupportComparison. Cancel the invertible derived graph maps in the base-change and proper-refinement identities to obtain the three required equations.
